gloss: new place to move to; moving destination

definitions.gloss: new place to move to; moving destination
definitions.explanation: The place where someone is moving to or has moved to. Refers to the destination of a residential or office move.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}はもう{決|き}まった？
examples.english: Have you decided where you're moving to?

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the address of your new place.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}が{駅|えき}から{遠|とお}くて、{毎朝|まいあさ}バスに{乗|の}らなければならない。
examples.english: My new place is far from the station, so I have to take the bus every morning.

notes:
Compound of {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し (moving, relocation) + {先|さき} (destination). Used when talking about the place someone is relocating to.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}が{決|き}まる: the new place is decided
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}を{探|さが}す: to look for a new place to live
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{先|さき}の{住所|じゅうしょ}: the address of the new place

RELATED WORDS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: the act of moving
- {転居先|てんきょさき}: new address (more formal)
- {移転先|いてんさき}: relocation destination (often for businesses)
